source: 上外版选择性必修第一册 Unit 1 同主题完形(听力建议博客/学习习惯30天/学习社团采访/老钢琴家/读书的力量/做中学反思)。用词限本单元/初中/常见词,答案唯一,选项同词性,与阅读听力不撞文章。

passages.title: Advice on Improving English
passages.text: Learning English well takes time and the right (1)____. My biggest problem used to be listening: when native speakers talked fast, I could (2)____ only a few words. A classmate gave me some useful (3)____. She told me to listen to English radio every day so that I could get (4)____ to the speed. I also began to (5)____ my own voice and compare it with the host's, which helped me hear my own (6)____. Little by little, my listening (7)____, and I felt much more (8)____ when foreigners spoke to me. The most important thing, I learned, is never to (9)____ up. If you keep practising, your skills will surely (10)____. Learning a language is a long road, but every small step counts.

passages.title: Thirty Days of a New Habit
passages.text: A speaker once shared a simple idea: try something (1)____ for thirty days. He explained that a month is just long (2)____ to add a good habit or drop a bad one. During his own thirty-day (3)____, he hiked up a mountain and even started to (4)____ a short book. The experience made him feel more confident and (5)____. He gave one piece of (6)____: keep your goals small and (7)____, so that you can really stick to them. A big dream is wonderful, but it is the small daily (8)____ that finally bring change. By the (9)____ of a month, you may be surprised at how much you have (10)____. The secret of lifelong learning, he said, is simply to begin and to keep going.

passages.title: An Interview about Learning
passages.text: Our school newspaper is holding an (1)____ about what students learn outside the classroom. One girl said the Go Green Club had (2)____ her most of all. She has been a (3)____ there for over a year, taking part in many activities that raise (4)____ of environmental protection. Through this work, she has (5)____ practical knowledge about how to protect nature. Her sense of (6)____ and her team spirit have also grown. 'Learning,' she said, 'is never (7)____ to classrooms. It can happen anywhere, as long as you are (8)____ to try.' She added that working with others had taught her how to (9)____ as a team. By the end of the interview, everyone agreed that out-of-class activities can be just as (10)____ as ordinary lessons.

passages.title: The Ninety-Year-Old Piano Man
passages.text: Jack is a remarkable old man who is still (1)____ to learn. He joined the army many years ago, but only late in life did he begin to (2)____ the piano. passages.title: The Power of Reading
passages.text: When I was young, books opened a door to a wider (1)____. My grandfather, who was a quiet (2)____, kept a shelf full of stories and poems. Reading taught me that real (5)____ is to know how little we actually know. It also gave me the (6)____ to ask questions and to think for myself. Whenever I felt sad, a good book could (7)____ me and lift my mood. Books, I learned, are patient teachers that never (8)____ giving us their wisdom. They connect us with people who lived (9)____ years ago. Now I believe that anyone who keeps reading will keep (10)____ for a whole lifetime.

passages.title: What I Learned by Doing
passages.text: Last term I joined a design course that completely changed the way I (1)____. Instead of sitting and listening, we learned by (2)____ things with our own hands.
